systems.system: Civil and Criminal Identification Integrated Management Platform (PGIBI)

note: A global identity-coverage dataset: for Angola it says only that the country is among those furthest behind on under-5 birth registration, and Annex D lists its foundational ID system (PGIBI, no digital ID, adult estimate from 2019 administrative data). The Annex D table's rows are misaligned in the transcription, so the PGIBI row is read as Angola's by position. Nothing on how a registry office records a birth or death.
